evidence: The La2O3 films were deposited at 300°C using tris(isopropyl-cyclopentadienyl)lanthanum (i-PrCp)3La as a lanthanum precursor and O2 plasma as a reactant. The basic cycle of the La2O3 deposition process consisted of four steps: (i) introducing the lanthanum precursor into the reaction chamber for 5 s with Ar carrier gas, (ii) purging the residual precursor and by-products from the chamber using Ar gas for 10 s, (iii) exposing to an oxygen plasma for 5 s, and (iv) purging the reactants and by-products from the chamber using Ar gas for 10 s.
